# h3_database_poolers (Data Source)

Connection poolers (PgBouncer) of a PostgreSQL `h3_database`, including poolers created in the console or taken over by h3db (`adopted`), with the connection budget and the limits of the database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_database_poolers" "pg" {
  database_id = h3_database.pg.id
}

output "poolers" {
  value = { for p in data.h3_database_poolers.pg.poolers : p.pooler_id => "${p.role}/${p.mode} ${p.ready_instances}/${p.instances} ${p.phase}" }
}

output "pooler_budget_primary" {
  value = data.h3_database_poolers.pg.budget.primary # { used, max }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) ID of the `h3_database`

### Read-Only

- `budget` (Attributes) Server connection budget of the database; null when h3db does not report it (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget))
- `limits` (Attributes) Limits of h3db; null when not reported (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `poolers` (Attributes List) Poolers, in the order h3db returns them (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poolers))

<a id="nestedatt--budget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget`

Read-Only:

- `max_connections` (Number) max_connections of the database
- `primary` (Attributes) Budget of the primary (poolers `rw` and `r`) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget--primary))
- `replica` (Attributes) Budget of each replica (poolers `ro` and `r`) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budget--replica))
- `reserve` (Number) Connections kept free for direct sessions

<a id="nestedatt--budget--primary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget.primary`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) max_connections of the instance
- `used` (Number) Connections taken by the poolers (instances × max_db_connections) plus the reserve


<a id="nestedatt--budget--replica"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget.replica`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) max_connections of the instance
- `used` (Number) Connections taken by the poolers (instances × max_db_connections) plus the reserve



<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `default_ports` (Map of Number) Default VPC port per role (`rw`, `ro`, `r`)
- `max_instances` (Number) PgBouncer pods per pooler
- `max_poolers` (Number) Poolers per database
- `port_max` (Number) Highest listener port
- `port_min` (Number) Lowest listener port


<a id="nestedatt--poolers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poolers`

Read-Only:

- `adopted` (Boolean) Created outside h3db and taken over
- `default` (Boolean) The default pooler of the database
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the console
- `effective_parameters` (Map of String) Parameters in effect
- `instances` (Number) PgBouncer pods requested
- `k8s_name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes Pooler object
- `mode` (String) `session` or `transaction`
- `parameters` (Map of String) Parameters set by the user
- `paused` (Boolean) Paused (PgBouncer `PAUSE`)
- `phase` (String) `READY`, `PROGRESSING`, `PAUSED` or `STOPPED`
- `pooler_id` (String) Pooler ID
- `public_addresses` (Attributes List) Listeners of the pooler on the public EIP of the database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poolers--public_addresses))
- `public_endpoints` (List of String) `<ip>:<port>` on the public EIP
- `ready_instances` (Number) Ready PgBouncer pods
- `role` (String) `rw`, `ro` or `r`
- `vpc_endpoint` (String) `<ip>:<port>` in the VPC
- `vpc_ip` (String) IP of the VPC listener
- `vpc_mode` (String) `port`, `address` or `none`
- `vpc_port` (Number) Port of the VPC listener
- `vpc_status` (String) `assigned`, `pending` or `unavailable`

<a id="nestedatt--poolers--public_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poolers.public_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `eip_id` (String) Elastic IP ID
- `endpoint` (String) `<ip>:<port>`
- `ip` (String) Public IP
- `port` (Number) Port
- `via` (String) `port-sources`, `service` or `external`
